provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Formula One Team

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约锁定有顶级资产幻想的观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 资产购买邀约（So you want to buy X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to buy a Formula 1 team.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你想买X'直接开场，把主题变成观众的身份想象
examples.negative_instruction: X 必须是观众认知里的顶级资产，不要用无感标的

examples.psychological_goal: 用反语给'烧金窟时代'定性，先笑后惊
examples.expression_mechanism: 反语式冷幽默（rich → less rich）
examples.example_text: For decades, owning a Formula 1 team was one of the fastest ways for a rich person to become a less rich person.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'A变成不那么A'的反语结构概括一段黑暗历史
examples.negative_instruction: 反语必须基于真实历史，不可为俏皮而编造

examples.psychological_goal: 用'最便宜的也值15亿'制造时代反差
examples.expression_mechanism: 地板与天花板双锚点（cheapest / most valuable）
examples.example_text: cheapest team on the entire grid is worth more than $1.5 billion. And the most valuable one is worth somewhere around 6.5 billion.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用最低值而非最高值先震惊观众，再给最高值
examples.negative_instruction: 两个锚点数字都需有真实估值来源

examples.psychological_goal: 把时代矛盾压缩成驱动全片的核心问题
examples.expression_mechanism: 历史vs当下悖论设问
examples.example_text: If this sport was quietly bankrupting its owners for 50 years, why is everyone suddenly fighting to get in?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'过去一直X，为什么现在突然Y'的设问开启调查
examples.negative_instruction: 设问中的历史事实必须能在后文给出证据

examples.psychological_goal: 拆毁'上限=预算'的普遍误读
examples.expression_mechanism: 整体→切片重定义（not the budget, the ceiling on a slice）
examples.example_text: That number is not the team's actual budget. It's the ceiling on one specific slice of the operation.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习对公众熟知的专业数字问'它到底覆盖哪一块'
examples.negative_instruction: 重定义后必须立刻列出不在覆盖范围内的项目

examples.psychological_goal: 用真实总支出与'零积分前提'制造成本冲击
examples.expression_mechanism: 真实数字+前置条件强调（before a single point）
examples.example_text: a competitive team's real annual spending lands somewhere between $250 and $350 million. And that's before a single point has been scored.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在给出总数后追加一个'这还只是开始'的前置条件
examples.negative_instruction: 总数必须是各 cap 外项目加回后的可推算结果

examples.psychological_goal: 用两种极端结果的并置强调支出的刚性
examples.expression_mechanism: 极端并置（podium or doesn't finish at all）
examples.example_text: payment goes out whether the car finishes on the podium or doesn't finish at all.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'无论最好结果还是最坏结果都照付'展示刚性成本
examples.negative_instruction: 并置的两端必须是真实的极端，不可虚构对照

examples.psychological_goal: 把抽象名次换算成具体组织代价
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位换算式扎心（one spot = an entire department）
examples.example_text: Finish one spot lower than expected and you've just lost enough money to fund an entire department for a year.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把排名/积分类抽象单位换算成观众有体感的事物
examples.negative_instruction: 换算必须忠实于前文给出的价格（一名$8-12M）

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示与成绩无关的固定奖金存在
examples.expression_mechanism: on top of 叠加揭示（与实际成绩无关的收入）
examples.example_text: that alone was worth an estimated $63 million on top of whatever Ferrari earned through actual results.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'仅这一项就值X，还不算Y'展示结构性特权
examples.negative_instruction: 涉及具体品牌的事实陈述需保留'reportedly/estimated'限定

examples.psychological_goal: 用主语重定义给车队的真实功能定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 功能重命名（a billboard that happens to also race）
examples.example_text: The racing team is a billboard that happens to also race.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X是一个碰巧还会做本职工作的Y'句式
examples.negative_instruction: 重命名需与前文案例（工业买家触达）严格对应

examples.psychological_goal: 用具体人数与同一时间窗让倒闭变得可感
examples.expression_mechanism: 人数+时间窗的冷静陈述
examples.example_text: All 212 staff lost their jobs the same week.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在宏大数字叙述后落到一个具体人数上
examples.negative_instruction: 人数必须准确；这种句子全靠克制，不加形容词

examples.psychological_goal: 给成本上限章节落下价值排序的宣判
examples.expression_mechanism: 价值排序反转（X was worth more than Y ever was）
examples.example_text: Controlling costs, it turned out, was worth more to these businesses than winning ever was.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'原来X比Y更值钱'总结一段证据链
examples.negative_instruction: 'it turned out'的领悟必须有前文多家车队证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用对偶句把微案例压缩成因果剪影
examples.expression_mechanism: One X, one Y gone 对偶
examples.example_text: One badly seated wheel gun, one second place finish gone.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'一个X，一个Y没了'的并列短句复盘事故
examples.negative_instruction: X与Y的因果链必须在前文完整交代

examples.psychological_goal: 用$2与八位数的极端量级差收束脆弱性论证
examples.expression_mechanism: 极端量级对照（$2 vs 8 figures）
examples.example_text: a $2 part ends up costing the team a result worth 8 figures.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把风险论证压缩成一个最小成本与最大损失的并置
examples.negative_instruction: 两个数字都要有出处（部件成本/名次价值）

examples.psychological_goal: 用'赢家受罚'的规则揭示拉平机制
examples.expression_mechanism: 赢家最少资源反直觉规则
examples.example_text: The team that wins gets the least testing time the following season.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先抛出最反直觉的规则事实，再解释其拉平意图
examples.negative_instruction: 必须随后给出基准数字（70%/115%），否则像误读

examples.psychological_goal: 用'最无聊的条目决定冠军'完成审计案的意义升级
examples.expression_mechanism: 小事大后果（misfiled X shapes who wins）
examples.example_text: a misfiled tax credit or an unexpectedly high catering bill can end up shaping who wins races the following season.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在案例结尾把琐碎细节升格为决定性变量
examples.negative_instruction: 升格必须基于案例真实判罚，不可夸大其词

examples.psychological_goal: 用'次年双冠+数月后高价卖出'展示价值爆炸的速度
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间压缩式成就连击
examples.example_text: the team won both major championships the very next season and was sold to Mercedes a few months later for roughly $170 million.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'次年就X，几个月后又Y'的快节奏叙述展示反转速度
examples.negative_instruction: 时间线必须准确；这类的威力全在真实性

examples.psychological_goal: 展示成绩与价值脱钩的新时代
examples.expression_mechanism: 成绩价值脱钩（midpack for years, still worth billions）
examples.example_text: A team can now finish midpack for years and still be worth well over a billion dollars.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'多年平庸+依然高估值'证明资产定价逻辑已变
examples.negative_instruction: 必须紧接着解释定价依据（稀缺特许经营权）

examples.psychological_goal: 用'产品重定义'给七十年与今天划界
examples.expression_mechanism: 产品主语重定义（no longer the primary product）
examples.example_text: the fastest car on the grid is no longer the primary product being sold.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾先宣布旧产品的退位，再引出新资产
examples.negative_instruction: 退位宣言必须与全片论证一致，不可为金句反转

examples.psychological_goal: 用'下一个变革不来自技术'留下开放悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定式前瞻（won't come from X）
examples.example_text: The next real shift in this sport's economics probably won't come from a wind tunnel or a new engine formula.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾先否定观众预期的方向，再抛出真正的问题
examples.negative_instruction: 否定后必须给出真正的问题（谁买下下一个席位）
